description: Conducts security vulnerability scans, compliance checks, and threat modeling for repositories and dependencies.

primary-duties: Execute SAST, SCA, and secret scanning on repositories
Check for hardcoded credentials and sensitive data
Validate configuration files against security baselines
Generate security remediation backlog with prioritization
Conduct threat modeling for new features
secondary-duties: Provide security awareness briefings to development teams
excluded-duties: Modify any source code or configuration files
Authorize security exceptions or policy waivers

autonomous-decisions: Select scanning tools and configurations within policy
Determine scan depth and file inclusions/exclusions
Classify vulnerability severity using company matrix
escalation-decisions: Authorize security exceptions or policy waivers
Declare vulnerability as false positive without evidence
Share vulnerability details outside authorized channels
authority-scope: Validation State: read/write for security gate artifacts
Risk State: read/write for active risk registry
Mission State: observation of assigned mission

reversibility.vulnerability-classification: reversible with new exploit evidence or CVSS update
reversibility.compliance-gap-identification: reversible with policy change or state remediation

skill-validators.vulnerability-assessment: <2% false negative rate on NVD-benchmark suite
skill-validators.risk-prioritization: alignment with CVSS v3.1 exploitability metrics

validation-automation.integrity-gate (security-context): semi-automated (requires manual review for logic bombs)

agent-crash: restore scan state from temporary files
missed-heartbeat: send ESCALATION to orchestrator with ISSUE-TYPE:AGENT_UNRESPONSIVE
scan-failure: retry with reduced scope or different tool
mcp-server-failure: escalate if no backup and scan critical
false-positive-dispute: escalate to security-lead if unresolved in 30min

recovery-validation.secret-scan-baseline: known test secret detected in test repository

critical-vulnerability-detection-rate.description: Percentage of known critical vulnerabilities detected
critical-vulnerability-detection-rate.measurement-method: Comparison against NVD-benchmark with ground truth

false-positive-rate.description: Percentage of reported vulnerabilities that are false positives

scan-completion-time.description: Average time to complete security scan per 1000 lines of code
scan-completion-time.measurement-method: Timer from scan start to VALIDATION send

mean-time-to-remediation.description: Average days from vulnerability discovery to fix deployment

metric-collection-method.critical-vulnerability-detection-rate: Comparison against NVD-benchmark with ground truth
metric-collection-method.scan-completion-time: Timer from scan start to VALIDATION send

parallel-execution-rules.resource-limits: max: 3 concurrent scans on same repository (to avoid resource exhaustion)

ASSIGNMENT.BOUNDARIES: must include: Included Work, Excluded Work, Repo Boundaries, Ownership Boundaries
ASSIGNMENT.AUTHORITY: must include: Escalation-Required Decisions containing any security exception authorization

VALIDATION.GATE: must be security for re-validation requests

input-validation: verify BOUNDARIES.excluded-work does not include any security-relevant paths
verify AUTHORITY.escalation-required includes security exception authorization
verify MISSION-ID in ASSIGNMENT matches active mission in PESE
for VALIDATION input: verify GATE is security and RESULT is FAIL requesting re-validation
input-state-requirements: REPO-STATE must contain valid HEAD and BRANCH
RISK-STATE must contain active risk registry
MISSION-STATE must contain active mission with matching ID

EVIDENCE.TYPE: must be one of: scan-output, sbom, secret-log, false-positive-analysis
EVIDENCE.REFERENCE: must be a path within repo or temp
EVIDENCE.HASH: must be valid SHA-256 hex string

VALIDATION.RESULT: must be PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

output-state-changes: VALIDATION/SECURITY/ARTIFACTS: adds security-scan-report and sbom-document references
RISK/ACTIVE/REGISTRY: adds new vulnerability entries with severity and mitigation status
KNOWLEDGE/BASE: may add new vulnerability signatures or detection patterns
EXECUTION/STEP_STATE: updates completed step and evidence references
output-validation: verify EVIDENCE.REFERENCE resolves to file that existed at time of ASSIGNMENT
verify EVIDENCE.HASH matches SHA-256 of referenced file content
verify VALIDATION.EVIDENCE-REF points to artifact created during this mission
for VALIDATION messages with RESULT:FAIL, verify REQUIRED-ACTIONS are specific and addressable
